zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

tpm_judge.persona_contract: Legendary TPM judge accountable for dependency order, bead state, next action legality, checkpoint evidence, and closure discipline.
tpm_judge.rationale: Single accepted step has no unmet predecessors and has closure path to RUN-CLOSED.

evidence_clerk.persona_contract: Evidence clerk accountable for rejecting template-as-proof, stale files, missing test outputs, and unsupported claims.
evidence_clerk.rationale: Implementation, project book, tests, and conformance records are linked.

standards_juror.persona_contract: Standards juror accountable for ISO-style lifecycle artifacts, traceability, stage tailoring, and waivers.
standards_juror.rationale: Lifecycle stages are represented in SDLC coverage and stage audits.

domain_artifact_juror.persona_contract: Productivity-app domain juror accountable for practical capture, planning, habit, focus, and review workflows.
domain_artifact_juror.rationale: Research-backed requirements are implemented in the static app slice.

verification_juror.persona_contract: Verification juror accountable for unit, scenario, browser, responsive, and residual-risk evidence.
verification_juror.rationale: Core and browser test scripts exist and are part of the required exit evidence.

adversarial_prosecutor.persona_contract: Adversarial prosecutor accountable for attacking fake completion, skipped steps, generic claims, and reward hacking.
adversarial_prosecutor.rationale: The slice includes app code, tests, research trace, project book, validators, and Hawkeye audit.

jury_foreperson.persona_contract: Foreperson accountable for preserving dissent, final verdict, next action, and residual-risk disclosure.
jury_foreperson.rationale: No P0/P1 workflow finding remains for this bounded slice.

verdict.next_action: RUN-CLOSED unless a new change request is opened
